convert_box_mode: convert boxes between XYXY_ABS, XYWH_ABS, and XYWHA_ABS coordinate formats
create_boxes_object: create a Boxes object from a list of (x1, y1, x2, y2) coordinates for batched box operations
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union between all N x M pairs of boxes
clip_boxes_to_image: clip boxes to image boundaries and filter nonempty boxes by area threshold
compute_point_box_distances: compute pairwise distances from N points to M boxes represented as distances to each edge
